name: Brakka Ironvein
opening: Brakka Ironvein served six years as a guard at the Temple of the Anvil Father in Greyhollow, a mining town cut into a cold mountainside. Three days ago three miners went down into the old north workings, which were sealed a generation ago, and none came back. Last night a fourth man came up out of the dark alone, babbling about lights that walk, then died before dawn. The town council will brick up the mine entrance at sunrise tomorrow, missing miners or not. The temple's prior, an old dwarf named Hessa, has asked Brakka to go down before then and bring back whoever can still be brought back. It is late afternoon, and Brakka stands at the mine mouth with a lantern borrowed from the temple.
